features: Asset Offline and Online notes list the affected stations, reported failure types and the operator's note
Queued response-record updates and chat notifications survive rate limits, outages and restarts
A persistent error panel names the failed operation and the saved line status
Anti-aliased rounded shapes and DPI-independent text on Raspberry Pi displays
Cleaner, touch-sized Settings with drag scrolling and wrapped descriptions
fixes: Completing a repair or planned work no longer fails to save and leaves the terminal inconsistent
A save that cannot be completed restores the last saved state instead of poisoning later actions
A retried release keeps the first confirmed release time, so durations do not grow
Response-record completion, comments, asset status and messages are no longer skipped
Completion messages preserve delivery evidence and never treat abandoned updates as DONE
Release timing starts at the affirmative confirmation touch, not when its dialog opens
Team and chat names can be typed in Settings even when a directory is loaded
Save and Cancel stay visible in Settings on 800 x 480 panels
Every documented message-template placeholder formats without error
release.release_summary: Reliability release: repair and planned-work completion is saved atomically, every follow-up update and notification is queued and retried, failures are explained precisely, team and chat names are editable, and the touchscreen renders with anti-aliased edges.
security: State changes are validated on an isolated snapshot before an atomic write
Bounded durable queues with expiry and audited abandonment
Idle state files remain readable by 1.0.0 for safe rollback
